groups.label: Bacteria
groups.explain: Single-celled organisms with no nucleus. Antibiotics act on bacteria.

groups.label: Viruses
groups.explain: Viruses copy themselves inside our cells. Antibiotics do not work on them.

groups.label: Fungi
groups.explain: Yeasts and moulds. Antifungal medicines act on them.

groups.label: Parasites
groups.explain: Organisms that live on or in a host. Plasmodium causes malaria.

groups.label: Farm animals
groups.explain: Antimicrobial use in animals also adds selection pressure.

groups.label: The environment
groups.explain: Resistant microbes and genes can move through soil and water.

groups.label: Places people get care
groups.explain: Where people, medicines and microbes meet.

groups.label: Ways to prevent infection
groups.explain: Fewer infections means fewer antimicrobials are needed.

groups.label: Sources of genetic change
groups.explain: Random mutation, plus three ways bacteria pass genes to each other.

groups.label: Resistance mechanisms
groups.explain: Ways a resistant bacterium survives a medicine.

groups.label: Drivers of selection pressure
groups.explain: Each one exposes microbes to medicines without need, so resistant ones survive and spread.

groups.label: Prevention
groups.explain: Stopping infections before they start.

groups.label: Caused by bacteria
groups.explain: Bacterial infections. Only a health worker can decide if antibiotics are needed.

groups.label: Caused by viruses
groups.explain: Viral infections. Antibiotics do not help them.

groups.label: Caused by fungi
groups.explain: Ringworm is a fungus, not a worm.

groups.label: Caused by parasites
groups.explain: Caused by protozoa, worms or mites.

groups.label: Bacterial shapes
groups.explain: Round, rod, spiral and comma shapes.

groups.label: Bacterial structures
groups.explain: Parts that help bacteria move, attach, hide and keep their shape.

groups.label: Lab tests
groups.explain: Tools that show which microbe is present and which medicines still work on it.

groups.label: Infection control
groups.explain: Stops microbes spreading in health facilities.
